opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: The awards cover tuition fees only, up to a maximum of £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low-income households who are ineligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government; ordinarily resident in Scotland with at least two years of secondary schooling/college in Scotland or a substantial recent connection to Scotland; entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK, have Limited Leave to Remain for the course duration, or be an asylum seeker; not eligible for public funds towards tuition fees; not already graduated with a university degree (except limited 2nd-degree cases). Must have an offer or be a continuing student on an eligible undergraduate degree course at a listed Scottish institution.
opportunities.summary: Grants covering the cost of tuition fees (up to £1,820 per year) for undergraduate degree students at Scottish institutions from low-income households who are not eligible for government tuition fee funding.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie-Morgan Scholarship

amount.raw: Full tuition fees for the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants plus an additional living-cost bursary of £1,200.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scottish-domiciled students from low-income households who have been accepted onto the MSc Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants (full-time or part-time) with the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh/University of Edinburgh; ordinarily resident in Scotland; have completed two years of Scottish secondary schooling/college or a substantive connection to Scotland; entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK; have drawn down SAAS living-cost loan funding; not eligible for public grant funding towards the course; not already hold a postgraduate degree.
opportunities.summary: A scholarship developed in partnership with the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh covering full tuition fees and a living-cost bursary for the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants, to widen participation in postgraduate study in plant science and botany.
